name: foundry
description: Growth ops kernel for ad agencies: deterministic account audit, diagnose, EN/AR client reports and COD-aware ROAS maths. Live Google/Meta changes need a human typing the campaign key at a real terminal.

interface.shortDescription: Audit ad accounts, write client reports, and run ROAS maths. Live writes need a human.
interface.longDescription: Foundry gives Codex deterministic growth-ops commands for ad agencies: a 0-100 account audit, the single biggest constraint, decision-first client reports in English or Arabic, and break-even and COD-aware ROAS calculators. Reports and client data live in your own workspace, never inside the plugin. Live Google Ads and Meta changes (pause, budget) are enforced in code to need a person typing the campaign key at a real terminal, so an agent cannot approve them itself.
defaultPrompt: Audit the Acme client account and tell me the weakest dimension.
Work out my break-even CPA and ROAS for a COD product.
Write an Arabic client report for Acme.
